Chronobiology.subject: Environment & Ecology
Chronobiology.question: The _____ was Study of rhythms in biological processes of living organisms.
Chronobiology.fact: Chronobiology is a field of biology that examines timing processes, including periodic (cyclic) phenomena in living organisms, such as their adaptation to solar- and lunar-related rhythms. Chronobiology comes from the ancient Greek χρόνος (chrónos, meaning "time"), and biology, which pertains to the study, or science, of life.
